messages:
alex_sales: Passing Hemlock Health to CS + Support. Deal details: $140k ARR, Dedicated GPUs, Private VPC, 12mo. Kickoff target 2028-07-12. PO linked.
alex_sales: Customer asks: BAA signed, Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS, EU+US residency split, p95 <130ms. Procurement requested monthly usage report.
joy_cs: Thanks  dropping PO and contacts? Also any custom model plans?
alex_sales: PO: https://drive.redwood.com/hemlock_po.pdf. Contacts: dana@hemlock.health (tech), arun@hemlock.health (procurement). They plan to use a tuned clinical-lite model + embeddings.
leo_onboard: Onboarding Qs: raw PHI or tokenized payloads? expected steady RPS and burst windows?
alex_sales: Raw PHI for initial pilot. Steady 90 rps, bursts to 450 rps for marketing drives (~72h). Monthly export ~40GB.
sam_support: Creating ticket CS-4112 for VPC peering & firewall checklist. Need CIDR, VPN endpoints, ASN. Attaching initial traceroute shows 0.5% packet loss intermittently.
eva_eng: Infra note: need staging creds + anonymized sample set for perf & quality tests. Perf plan: perf-run --model clinical-lite --n 800 --batch 8. If p95>130ms we'll test batching and INT8.
joy_cs: Proposed owners: joy_cs (CS lead), leo_onboard (onboarding), sam_support (support), eva_eng (eng), alex_sales (sales escalation). I'll create runbook and kickoff invite.
alex_sales: Procurement also requested per-route cost breakdown. I'll share pricing workbook.
leo_onboard: Kickoff scheduled 2028-07-12 10:00 PT. Agenda: demo, sample data transfer, peering steps, perf expectations. I'll ask for anonymized sample during call.
joy_cs: Action items recap: 1) Leo schedule kickoff; 2) Sam open CS-4112 and get VPN details; 3) Eva run perf once staging ready; 4) CS to set 30/60/90 health checks and weekly status emails for first 8 weeks. Renewal owner: alex_sales. Renewal risk: medium-high until first 90 days.
notif-bot: CS-4112 transitioned to "In Progress" by sam_support.
joy_cs: I'll draft CS playbook in Confluence and post link. We'll open a 30-day checkpoint thread post-launch.
